description: This file defines a static class 'Section4Flows' that provides various asynchronous static methods for listing different data entities related to Section 4 modules, such as site profiles, process streams, raw materials, SDS, lab data configurations, and water process configurations. Each method logs its start and delegates the data retrieval to a 'Section4Repository' with an optional siteId filter and limit.

classes.name: Section4Flows
classes.description: Contains static methods to list various data entities for Section 4 modules with logging and filtering.

methods.name: ListSiteProfilesAsync
methods.description: Lists site profiles with an optional siteId filter, normalizes limit, logs execution, delegates to repository.

methods.name: ListWwtsProcessStreamsAsync
methods.description: Lists WWTS process streams with optional siteId filter, normalized limit, with logging.

methods.name: ListChemicalRawMaterialsAsync
methods.description: Lists chemical raw materials with optional siteId filter, normalized limit, with logging.

methods.name: ListChemicalSdsAsync
methods.description: Lists chemical SDS rows with optional siteId filter, normalized limit, with logging.

methods.name: ListLabDataConfigurationsAsync
methods.description: Lists lab data configurations with optional siteId filter, normalized limit, with logging.

methods.name: ListWaterProcessConfigurationsAsync
methods.description: Lists water process configurations with optional siteId filter, normalized limit, with logging.
